description: This file contains Python classes 'ProcessJsonData' and 'DashBoardGenerator' for processing JSON test results and generating a dashboard, including methods for reading, processing, and archiving test results, as well as creating HTML dashboards.

classes.name: ProcessJsonData
classes.description: Handles processing and archiving of JSON test result data, including recursive result extraction and result archiving.

classes.name: DashBoardGenerator
classes.description: Generates a test results dashboard by initializing, processing archived results, and creating HTML and JSON output files.

methods.name: _get_test_result
methods.description: Determines test result status based on actual and expected values.

methods.name: _recurse_json_object
methods.description: Recursively traverses JSON object to find specific test result.

methods.name: _process_previous_json_results
methods.description: Processes previous test results for comparison.

methods.name: _add_archived_result
methods.description: Adds archived test results to JSON object.

methods.name: _process_json_object
methods.description: Recursively processes JSON test result objects to archive results.

methods.name: generate_archived_result
methods.description: Generates archived test results JSON structure.

methods.name: _add_individual_result_links
methods.description: Adds hyperlinks to individual test result HTML files.

methods.name: _copy_dashboard_html
methods.description: Copies dashboard HTML template if not present.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Initializes test result data by reading files and setting up data structures.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Main method to generate the dashboard and save results.
